subject: Novavale trial planning — ownership lanes & action items
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@novavale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Novavale trial planning — ownership lanes & action items

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a concrete set of next steps so we can get the trial moving next week. I pulled together a short runbook and an initial ownership lane map (attached).

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: Validate LLM inference for customer support summarization and privacy-sensitive search by ingesting a 90-day transcript slice.
- Success criteria (customer-facing):
  - Extract summaries with >= 0.82 ROUGE-L on our baseline prompt set (sample of 500 transcripts).
  - Average inference tail latency < 350ms p95 for 1–3 token completions under pilot load (burst 10rps).
  - No sensitive data egress — logs retained per your policy (30d) and audit logs available.
- Minimum trial length: 4 weeks (2 wks ingest/validation + 2 wks user acceptance).

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline (high-level):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MLP (mutual action plan), confirm SSO & IP allowlist, deliver test dataset slice.
- Week 1: Ingest + smoke tests (infra lead + app lead).
- Week 2: Run evaluation prompts, measure quality + perf, share interim results.
- Week 3–4: Customer validation, feedback loop, QA acceptance.

Ownership (initial lanes) — who owns what during trial: RACI-style, condensed:
- Data ingestion & anonymization: Responsible = Novavale (Sara / T. Lee), Consulted = Redwood (Ben)
- Serving infra (hosting, instance sizing, KV cache): Responsible = Redwood (Ben), Accountable = Redwood (Lauren)
- App integration + SDK usage: Responsible = Novavale devs (T. Lee), Consulted = Redwood (Kimberly)
- Security & compliance checks (audit logs, retention): Responsible = Novavale SecOps, Consulted = Redwood Security (Kimberly)
- Procurement / SOW signature: Responsible = Novavale procurement, Consulted = Redwood Sales (Lauren)

Action items (owners + ETA):
1) Sara: Confirm dataset delivery window and redacted sample by Fri 3/19. (Sara)
2) Ben: Prepare Dedicated vs Private cost outline and infra checklist by Mon 3/22. (Ben)
3) Kimberly: Draft security checklist (audit log exports, KMS options) by Mon 3/22. (Kimberly)
4) Lauren: Send MLP + Drive folder; schedule a technical kickoff for Wed 3/24 10:00 PT. (Lauren)

Attachments: novavale_trial_requirements.xlsx (contains sample schema + prompt set), redwood_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (MLP draft)

Notes: I flagged the data residency question Sara raised — Ben/Kimberly, if we need to run Private for the trial we should call that out in the MLP and cost outline.

Thanks — I’ll wait for Sara’s confirmation on dataset timing and we can lock the kickoff.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Novavale trial planning — ownership lanes & action items

Lauren / team / Sara — I put together the infra comparison and a quick cost sketch (summary below). Full cost spreadsheet attached in Drive (link in MLP).

Summary — Dedicated vs Private (trial):
- Dedicated (Redwood-managed GPU pool, us-west-2): Pros = fastest onboarding, predictable latency, audit logs available; Cons = customer data leaves Novavale network to Redwood infra behind our contract controls. Estimated incremental = $12k/month for trial footprint.
- Private (VPC / customer-managed Azure): Pros = data remains in-tenant, easiest for strict residency; Cons = onboarding ~1 week longer, dependency on Novavale infra team for network config. Estimated incremental = $18k/month (license + infra ops) for trial footprint.

Security ask: If Novavale prefers Dedicated, we can enforce tight egress rules + HSM-backed KMS; Kimberly, please attach the security checklist we discussed.

I also mapped a slightly expanded RACI (short):
- Infra sizing & setup: Responsible = Redwood (Ben) ; Consulted = Novavale (T. Lee)
- Network allowlist & peering: Responsible = Novavale (T. Lee) ; Accountable = Novavale SecOps
- Data redaction & validation: Responsible = Novavale (Sara / devs) ; Consulted = Redwood
- Acceptance & UAT signoff: Responsible = Novavale PM ; Accountable = Novavale Director (Sara)

Next steps from infra:
- Ben to run a short performance smoke (sample QPS) on a small Dedicated instance Wed 3/24; will share p95 numbers.
- Kimberly to post security checklist by Mon 3/22 (Kimberly?) — Kimberly: can you confirm timing?

Attachments: cost_sketch_summary.csv (in Drive), infra_smoke_template.txt (will attach output after run)

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Hi all — attaching the security checklist and a brief note on KMS options (see Drive link in MLP). Quick answers:

- If Novavale requires data to stay inside your Azure tenant, Private will be the path; expect a ~5–7 business day additional setup window for networking and on-prem connectors.
- For Dedicated with strict controls: we offer HSM-backed KMS and a locked-down egress policy; audit log exports are available daily.

Kimberly action items completed: checklist uploaded (redwood_security_checklist_v1.xlsx) and a short readme with KMS patterns.
